lore.common: Has one sticky button that adds an extra seven to every answer.
lore.uncommon: Spells HELLO when turned upside down, and the whole class giggles every single time.
lore.rare: Crunched a sum so long that the screen ran out of room and showed an E.
lore.epic: Added up the school dinner bill and got a number so big that the canteen closed for a week to check it.
lore.legendary: Divided a birthday cake into thirty perfectly equal slices, and still had a crumb left over for itself.

names.legendary: Coach Pulsebeat of the Sloth House

lore.common: Buzzes your wrist to tell you to stand up, just as you get comfy.
lore.uncommon: Counts arm-waving as steps, so its owner sits on the sofa waving.
lore.rare: Noticed its wearer's heart racing during a scary film and asked if they were exercising.
lore.epic: Counted the whole stadium doing the wave as exercise, and told everyone they could skip PE for a year.
lore.legendary: Counted every step a sloth took in a whole year, all eleven of them, and awarded it a gold star.

lore.common: Says recalculating every time you take a turn it didn't suggest.
lore.uncommon: Tells you to turn left into a field, a river or a farmer's barn.
lore.rare: Sent a delivery van down a lane so narrow that it had to reverse for a mile.
lore.epic: Sent every car on the motorway down the same tiny village road during a jam.
lore.legendary: Found a shortcut so clever that it went through the middle of next week. The family arrived before they set off.

names.legendary: Old Ohmsworth of the Potato Patch

lore.common: Pokes its two probes into everything, including your sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Has a dial with twenty settings, and everyone who borrows it just leaves it on the beeping one.
lore.rare: Found the broken fuse in a whole house of tangled wires in one minute.
lore.epic: Beeped its test so loudly in the school hall that every fire door swung open to see what was wrong.
lore.legendary: Tested a potato, found it had more power than the house, and now the family runs the telly on chips.

names.legendary: Old Truenorth of the Explorer's Pocket

lore.common: Spins its needle in circles every time you stand near the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Always points north, even when you'd rather go south for ice cream.
lore.rare: Points at the nearest lost thing instead of north. It has found four socks and a grandad.
lore.epic: Spun so hard on the school trip that the whole class walked in a circle for an hour and found their own coach.
lore.legendary: Pointed north so firmly that it dragged its explorer all the way to the North Pole, still in his pyjamas.

lore.common: Hides in the bottom of your rucksack just when you need it.
lore.uncommon: Hangs on your keyring and points north every time you check the time.
lore.rare: Swings round to point at the nearest snack shop whenever its owner sighs.
lore.epic: Pointed the whole scout camp to the wrong hill, and they spent the night with some very surprised sheep.
lore.legendary: Was swallowed by a goose, which then flew straight north for a whole winter and never got lost once.

names.legendary: Old Hourglass of the Kitchen Shelf

lore.common: Runs out of sand just as you turn your back on the boiling pan.
lore.uncommon: Has to be turned upside down at exactly the right moment.
lore.rare: Turns itself over when nobody is watching, so every egg takes either one minute or an hour.
lore.epic: Ran its sand backwards at breakfast, and every boiled egg in the cafe turned raw again.
lore.legendary: Timed an egg so perfectly that it hatched on the very last grain. The chick is called Three Minutes.

names.legendary: Lady Dingwell, Keeper of Town Time

lore.common: Ticks so loudly on the counter that you can hear it from the garden.
lore.uncommon: Dings so suddenly that everyone in the kitchen jumps.
lore.rare: Was twisted round so far that it rang in the middle of the night.
lore.epic: Rang so loudly at the bake sale that every cake in the hall jumped and sank in the middle.
lore.legendary: Ticked so steadily that the town hall clock started copying it, and the town now runs on kitchen time.

names.legendary: Captain Lodestone of the Old Ship

lore.common: Swings its needle so wildly in a storm that the sailors feel seasick looking at it.
lore.uncommon: Sits in a brass case on the ship's deck and shines in the sun.
lore.rare: Pulls every spoon on the ship towards it, so the crew eat their soup with their fingers.
lore.epic: Pointed so firmly at a lighthouse that the whole fleet parked round it like cars at a supermarket.
lore.legendary: Steered a ship so straight that it sailed off the edge of the map, and the mapmaker had to add more sea.

lore.common: Flips its lid open at the wrong moment and catches on your jumper.
lore.uncommon: Ticks so loudly in its owner's pocket that the cat follows him around.
lore.rare: Made its owner late for everything by running five minutes slow.
lore.epic: Was checked by every passenger at the station when the train was late, and they all said tut.
lore.legendary: Ran slow for so long that it is now exactly one day behind, and its owner has every birthday twice.

lore.common: Loops across the waistcoat and catches on every door handle.
lore.uncommon: Tangles round the buttons every time you sit down.
lore.rare: Swung its fob so grandly that it hypnotised the dinner guests.
lore.epic: Got hooked on a coat rail at the station, and pulled a whole row of coats onto the platform.
lore.legendary: Swung its fob so steadily that a whole orchestra followed it like a conductor, and played better than ever.

names.legendary: Coach Splitsecond of the Snail Race

lore.common: Starts by accident in your pocket and runs all day.
lore.uncommon: Has a lap button that its owner forgets every race, so second place is always a guess.
lore.rare: Was reset at the exact moment someone broke the school record.
lore.epic: Stopped at the exact moment the school race began, so sports day lasted until midnight.
lore.legendary: Timed a snail racing a tortoise for three days and declared a draw. Both want a rematch.

names.legendary: Old Lapcounter of the Pool Deck

lore.common: Swings round its lanyard and hits the coach on the chin.
lore.uncommon: Is always next to the whistle, and gets blown into by mistake.
lore.rare: Timed every swimmer's split down to the hundredth of a second.
lore.epic: Beeped the start signal so early that the swimmers finished before the crowd had sat down.
lore.legendary: Timed a swimmer so fast that the pool water was still sloshing the next morning.

names.legendary: Lady Countdowna of the School Bell

lore.common: Beeps so loudly when it reaches zero that everyone drops what they're holding.
lore.uncommon: Has three buttons, and everyone presses the wrong one.
lore.rare: Was used as a chess clock, and both players ran out of time.
lore.epic: Counted down every round of the cooking show, and every chef finished with one second to spare.
lore.legendary: Counted down to the end of the school day so loudly that the school bell retired.

lore.common: Starts an update just as you sit down to play, and finishes just as you are called for dinner.
lore.uncommon: Whirrs its fan so loudly that it sounds like it's taking off.
lore.rare: Filled the screen with pop-up windows until you couldn't see the desktop.
lore.epic: Restarted to install one update and came back on a week later with a new wallpaper of a cat.
lore.legendary: Ran one game for so long without switching off that the characters went on holiday inside it.

names.legendary: Grand Servatrix of the Cold Room

lore.common: Hums all day and all night in a room nobody ever visits.
lore.uncommon: Has rows of blinking lights that look like it's thinking very hard.
lore.rare: Has never once been switched off, not even for a nap.
lore.epic: Handled every video in the country on the night of the big final, and didn't even sweat.
lore.legendary: Stored so many cat videos that it started purring, and the engineers now bring it a saucer of milk.

lore.common: Has so many cables behind it that nobody dares pull one out.
lore.uncommon: Stacks one server on top of another until it's taller than a person.
lore.rare: Is kept in a room so cold that the engineers wear winter coats in summer.
lore.epic: Blinked every light at once during the storm, and the engineers ran in with torches.
lore.legendary: Was unplugged for one second, and the whole town remembered how to talk to each other at dinner.

names.legendary: Lady Renderwell of the Design Studio

lore.common: Takes up the whole desk with its two screens and its giant keyboard.
lore.uncommon: Hogs every bit of power while it draws a single 3D teapot.
lore.rare: Got so hot during a render that its owner warmed their hands on it.
lore.epic: Rendered a whole animated film in one night with every computer in the studio.
lore.legendary: Designed a bridge so beautiful that the town named it after its owner.

lore.common: Gets its curly cord tangled every time someone walks across the hall.
lore.uncommon: Takes ages to dial, one clicking turn at a time.
lore.rare: Rang so loudly at midnight that the whole house woke up for a wrong number.
lore.epic: Rang in every house in the village at the same moment when the school called about snow.
lore.legendary: Got a wrong number so often that the family made friends with the caller, and she now comes for Sunday lunch.

lore.common: Wobbles so much on its highest speed that everyone below ducks.
lore.uncommon: Collects a thick line of dust on every blade.
lore.rare: Has a pull cord for the light and one for the fan, and you always pull the wrong one.
lore.epic: Whirled so fast on the hottest night that every paper in the house blew off the tables.
lore.legendary: Spun so fast at a dinner party that the whole table, plates and all, lifted off and floated to pudding.

names.legendary: Old Ventilus of the Bathroom Wall

lore.common: Rattles in the wall for ten minutes after you switch the light off.
lore.uncommon: Sucks the steam out of the bathroom and leaves the mirror clear.
lore.rare: Pulled the smell of fried fish out of the kitchen before the guests arrived.
lore.epic: Sucked so hard that it pulled the shower curtain, the bath mat and a rubber duck into the wall.
lore.legendary: Sucked a whole thundercloud out of the bathroom after a long shower, and now it rains in the garden whenever grandad washes.

lore.common: Blows hot air straight at your toes until they tingle.
lore.uncommon: Ticks and clicks as it warms up, like it's thinking about something.
lore.rare: Warmed a whole cold room in five minutes, and the cat moved in front of it forever.
lore.epic: Warmed the office so well that the plants grew bananas and the boss had to wear shorts.
lore.legendary: Was left on so long that the study now has its own little summer, with a deckchair and a sandcastle.

lore.common: Swivels back and forth so you only get a breeze half the time.
lore.uncommon: Blows so hard that the curtains wave at the neighbours all night.
lore.rare: Swivels to face whoever is talking and blows their words away before anyone hears.
lore.epic: Swivelled so fast in the heatwave that it blew the washing line over three gardens.
lore.legendary: Blew so steadily all summer that a kite has been flying in the bedroom since June.

lore.common: Has two thumbsticks, and you always push the wrong one.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when the battery is low just as the drone is over the lake.
lore.rare: Flew a drone so high that it filmed the whole town from above.
lore.epic: Flew its drones into the shape of a giant sandwich, and every seagull in the county came to the park.
lore.legendary: Landed a drone on a coin from the other side of the field.

lore.common: Is fiddled with by the dog all afternoon until it's crooked.
lore.uncommon: Stops a dog from barking at the postman, mostly.
lore.rare: Kept a very nervous dog calm through a whole visit to the vet.
lore.epic: Kept every dog at the vet so calm that the vet fell asleep in the waiting room instead.
lore.legendary: Calmed a dog so completely that the postman now stops for a cup of tea.

names.legendary: Captain Airwell of the School Play

lore.common: Snaps its elastic strap against your ear when you put it on.
lore.uncommon: Drops down from the plane ceiling during the safety talk, and every child stares.
lore.rare: Helped a mountain climber breathe at the very top of the highest peak.
lore.epic: Dropped down during the drill, and every passenger tried it on as a party hat.
lore.legendary: Was worn by the dragon in the school play to stop it breathing on the front row. It got a standing ovation.

lore.common: Fogs up the moment you stop at the top of the slope.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a white goggle-shaped tan on your face.
lore.rare: Has mirror lenses so shiny that the skier behind sees their own face.
lore.epic: Cut through a whiteout on the mountain so clearly that the whole ski school followed its wearer down.
lore.legendary: Saw through a blizzard so clearly that it spotted a yeti, who asked to borrow them.

names.legendary: Professor Spectacula of the Tech Fair

lore.common: Blinks notifications in front of your eyes while you're trying to read.
lore.uncommon: Talks to you in a tiny voice that nobody else can hear.
lore.rare: Recognised every face in the crowd and remembered everyone's name.
lore.epic: Translated a dog barking at the tech fair, and the dog was very rude about the robots.
lore.legendary: Translated a whole conversation in a foreign market so its wearer could buy the best mangoes.

lore.common: Gurgles water into your mouth every time a little wave comes along.
lore.uncommon: Has a mouthpiece that leaves teeth marks after every swim.
lore.rare: Dipped under the water so smoothly that the fish didn't notice it.
lore.epic: Peeked at every fish on the reef in one afternoon, and the fish started peeking back.
lore.legendary: Breathed so calmly on the reef that a turtle mistook it for a friend and took it home for tea.

lore.common: Fogs up after five minutes, so you see nothing but cloud.
lore.uncommon: Has a strap that tangles in your hair every time you take it off.
lore.rare: Showed its wearer a whole hidden world of fish under the jetty.
lore.epic: Fogged up so badly that its wearer swam to a different beach and sat down at the wrong picnic.
lore.legendary: Showed a child a fish so friendly that the fish now waits by the jetty every summer and waves.

lore.common: Squashes your eyes so tightly that you look like a panda after swimming.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its strap so hard that it stings the back of your head.
lore.rare: Let its wearer count every tile on the bottom of the pool.
lore.epic: Leaked so badly at the gala that a goldfish moved in halfway down the pool.
lore.legendary: Saw so clearly underwater that it found every hair clip ever lost in the pool, all four thousand of them.

names.legendary: Lady Virtua of the Other World

lore.common: Walks its wearer straight into the sofa while they think they're on a beach.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a red strap mark on your face and makes your forehead sweat.
lore.rare: Took its wearer to the bottom of the sea and the top of a volcano before lunch.
lore.epic: Had the whole family flailing round the living room at once, and the lamp didn't survive.
lore.legendary: Took grandma to the Moon in virtual reality, and she has refused to come back for tea.

names.legendary: Madame Bouclette of the Ring Road

lore.common: Touches your neck by accident and makes you yelp.
lore.uncommon: Twists straight hair into bouncy ringlets in a few seconds.
lore.rare: Left a faint smell of toasted hair floating round the bathroom.
lore.epic: Curled every head at the prom party, and the room looked like a field of springs.
lore.legendary: Curled a straight road into ringlets, and the bus now takes an hour to go one mile.

names.legendary: Sir Buzzworth of the Sheep Pen

lore.common: Leaves a little patch of stubble under the nose every morning, and nobody notices until lunchtime.
lore.uncommon: Spills tiny whiskers all over the sink every single day.
lore.rare: Glided over a scratchy chin so smoothly that the cat came for a stroke.
lore.epic: Shaved the garden hedge into the shape of grandad by mistake, and grandad is very proud.
lore.legendary: Shaved a woolly sheep so neatly that the sheep now asks for the same cut every spring.

lore.common: Tangles its cord round your arm every time you use it.
lore.uncommon: Flattens even the frizziest hair into a sheet of silk.
lore.rare: Sizzled a wet bit of hair so loudly that everyone thought it was frying bacon.
lore.epic: Straightened every child at the sleepover, and the curls were found next morning hiding under the bed.
lore.legendary: Straightened the spiral staircase, and grandma now takes the slide down.

lore.common: Thuds so loudly against your back that the neighbours hear it.
lore.uncommon: Pounds your shoulders like a tiny woodpecker.
lore.rare: Found a knot in its owner's back that had been there for three years.
lore.epic: Pounded the team so hard after the match that their legs kept running all night in their sleep.
lore.legendary: Thumped the knot out of an old oak tree, and the tree stood up straight for the first time in a hundred years.

names.legendary: Old Foilsworth of the Fruit Stall

lore.common: Has a cord so short that you have to shave bent over the sink.
lore.uncommon: Has a thin silver foil head that tickles your face.
lore.rare: Munched through a week of stubble in one pass.
lore.epic: Buzzed through the whole rugby team before the photo, and the changing room was full of whiskers.
lore.legendary: Shaved a peach so smoothly that the greengrocer sold it as a nectarine.

names.legendary: Sir Callwell of the Commuter Train

lore.common: Makes its wearer look like they're talking to nobody in the supermarket.
lore.uncommon: Slips out of your ear just as you lean over a puddle.
lore.rare: Paired with the wrong phone and played next door's music in your ear.
lore.epic: Paired with every phone on the train at once, and the whole carriage heard one man ordering pizza.
lore.legendary: Took a call for its owner while he slept and booked him a holiday he still has not unpacked from.

lore.common: Tangles its cord into a knot in your pocket.
lore.uncommon: Whispers instructions into its wearer's ear all day.
lore.rare: Gave the actor her cue at exactly the right moment, and nobody saw a thing.
lore.epic: Picked up a football commentary during the big show, and the actors cheered a goal in the sad scene.
lore.legendary: Whispered the lines so well that the actor fell asleep on stage and still gave his best performance ever.

lore.common: Whistles when someone hugs its wearer too close.
lore.uncommon: Turns the birdsong up so loud in the garden that grandad nods along like it is a concert.
lore.rare: Picked up a whisper from the other side of the room that wasn't meant to be heard.
lore.epic: Turned up the volume at the family dinner, and grandad heard every joke for the first time in years.
lore.legendary: Helped grandad hear his granddaughter's first words, and he still talks about it.

lore.common: Buzzes overhead like a giant wasp that won't leave the picnic.
lore.uncommon: Hops over the garden hedge to see what next door is doing.
lore.rare: Was chased round the park by every dog, and the dogs nearly won.
lore.epic: Followed an ice-cream van all afternoon, and half the town followed the drone.
lore.legendary: Delivered a birthday cake across the lake without dropping a single crumb.

lore.common: Bonks against the ceiling as soon as you turn it on.
lore.uncommon: Spins round in circles until the remote is pointed the right way.
lore.rare: Got caught in the curtains and hung there until dinner time.
lore.epic: Flew round every room in the house in one afternoon and scattered the cards off the table.
lore.legendary: Was flown for a hundred hours by the same child and only crashed into the cat twice.

lore.common: Puffs a cloud into the air that makes everyone sneeze.
lore.uncommon: Comes with a soft round pad that leaves a little circle on your nose.
lore.rare: Stopped the shine on an actor's nose under the hottest stage lights.
lore.epic: Puffed so much powder in the dressing room before the show that it looked like it had snowed.
lore.legendary: Powdered the nose of a clown so well that it vanished, and the circus is still looking for it.

names.legendary: Old Platterworth of the Desk Drawer

lore.common: Whirrs and clicks so loudly that it sounds like it's chewing.
lore.uncommon: Says it's full just when you want to save one more photo.
lore.rare: Held every family photo since the baby was born, all in one little box.
lore.epic: Spun so fast during the backup that it whirred off the desk and did a lap of the classroom.
lore.legendary: Was dropped down a flight of stairs, kept spinning, and saved a whole novel its owner had forgotten to back up.

lore.common: Gets set in the wrong place every time, so it catches slippers, socks and the dog's nose instead of mice.
lore.uncommon: Is set with a piece of cheese that the mouse always manages to steal.
lore.rare: Caught a toe instead of a mouse, and the toe's owner hopped round the kitchen.
lore.epic: Guarded the whole pantry for a winter, and the mice moved next door.
lore.legendary: Has guarded the same cellar for fifty years, and the mice now send it postcards from the barn.

names.legendary: Old Filterworth of the Engine Bay

lore.common: Drips greasy oil on your hands every time you touch it.
lore.uncommon: Has to be spun off with a special tool that nobody can find.
lore.rare: Caught so much dirt in the engine oil that the engine purred like new.
lore.epic: Burst during an oil change and turned the whole garage into a slip-and-slide for the afternoon.
lore.legendary: Cleaned the oil of an old tractor so well that it now overtakes the postman on hills.

names.legendary: Old Bladewell of the Pencil Pot

lore.common: Snaps the lead every time you sharpen your best pencil.
lore.uncommon: Spills curly shavings all over the desk when you open it.
lore.rare: Sharpened a pencil to a point so fine that it could write on a grain of rice.
lore.epic: Sharpened every pencil in the school before exams, and the classroom smelled like a forest.
lore.legendary: Sharpened one pencil so far that only the rubber was left, and it wrote one perfect full stop.

names.legendary: Old Rubberly of the Pencil Case

lore.common: Smudges the mistake into a grey cloud instead of rubbing it out.
lore.uncommon: Lives on the end of a pencil and gets chewed by nervous students.
lore.rare: Shed so many crumbs on the page that the desk looked like it was covered in sand.
lore.epic: Rubbed out the mistakes so hard that it rubbed out the homework, the desk and half of Tuesday.
lore.legendary: Has been rubbed down to a tiny stub after correcting a whole novel.

names.legendary: Sir Clickwell of the Car Park

lore.common: Is always in the other coat. Whichever coat you are wearing, it is in the other one.
lore.uncommon: Clicks the car locked three times because you keep checking.
lore.rare: Found the car in a huge car park by making it flash its lights.
lore.epic: Locked the car with the shopping, the dog and itself inside, and the dog honked the horn for help.
lore.legendary: Unlocked the car from the other side of town by mistake, and the car drove over to say hello.

names.legendary: Old Swipeworth of the Front Desk

lore.common: Beeps at the door and flashes red, so you have to try three times.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost in your pocket among all the other keys.
lore.rare: Opened every door in the building, even the one with the snacks in.
lore.epic: Was swiped by every worker at once on Monday morning, and the doors couldn't keep up.
lore.legendary: Was swiped so often that it opened a door that did not exist, and the office now has a secret room.

names.legendary: Old Jangleworth of the Hall Hook

lore.common: Jangles so loudly in your pocket that you can never sneak in late.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its clip open and drops all your keys down a drain.
lore.rare: Holds so many trinkets that it's heavier than the keys.
lore.epic: Snapped open at the station, and every key rolled onto a different train to a different town.
lore.legendary: Held so many keys that one opened a door nobody had found for a hundred years. Behind it was a spare key.

names.legendary: Old Turnwell of the Bike Shed

lore.common: Is so tiny that it slips through the floorboards.
lore.uncommon: Turns in the lock perfectly, then refuses to come back out until somebody says thank you.
lore.rare: Opened a padlock that had been rusted shut for years.
lore.epic: Fitted every bike lock in the school shed, and the bikes swapped owners for a week.
lore.legendary: Was lost so many times that it learned to walk home by itself, and now waits by the bike every morning.

lore.common: Never goes in the right way round on the first try.
lore.uncommon: Loses its little cap the first day you own it.
lore.rare: Shows a different file every time it is plugged in. The school project became a recipe for flapjacks.
lore.epic: Was plugged into the school computer and changed every screen in the building to a photo of a goat.
lore.legendary: Went in the right way round on the first try, once. People still talk about it.

lore.common: Collects crumbs from every lunch eaten at the desk.
lore.uncommon: Has one sticky key that types its letter twice.
lore.rare: Turned on caps lock so the whole email sounded like shouting.
lore.epic: Was typed on so fast at the deadline that the office sounded like rain.
lore.legendary: Typed so fast in one night that the letters wore off, and its owner now types by guessing. The emails are better.

lore.common: Gets carried round school in a trolley and is always the one with a sticky key.
lore.uncommon: Saves everything to the cloud, so nobody can say the dog ate their homework.
lore.rare: Snapped its lid shut on a ruler and refused to open again until lunch.
lore.epic: Logged in on every desk in the school at once on Monday morning, and the wifi took a deep breath.
lore.legendary: Saved the homework to the cloud so hard that it rained worksheets on the playground for a week.

lore.common: Has a screen so small that you squint to read anything.
lore.uncommon: Has keys so tiny that grown-ups type every word wrong.
lore.rare: Fitted into a handbag and did a whole day's work in a café.
lore.epic: Fell asleep on a train and woke up three countries away with its report written in all three languages.
lore.legendary: Wrote a novel so slowly on its tiny keys that the main character grew up and moved out.

lore.common: Yanks its wire off the desk every time you move it too far.
lore.uncommon: Double-clicks when you only meant to click once.
lore.rare: Surfed across the desk so fast that it fell off the edge.
lore.epic: Clicked through a thousand pages of homework in one evening.
lore.legendary: Was pushed so far across the desk that it reached the kitchen, and now clicks the kettle on.

lore.common: Hides down the side of the sofa just when it starts ringing.
lore.uncommon: Is never fully charged because it's never put back on its base.
lore.rare: Was taken into the garden for a call and left in the flower bed for a week.
lore.epic: Rang while lost somewhere in the house, and the whole family searched every room.
lore.legendary: Rang from inside the freezer, where it had been keeping cool all summer, with full battery.

lore.common: Snaps shut at the end of every call so loudly that everyone knows you've hung up.
lore.uncommon: Takes ages to text because every letter needs three button presses.
lore.rare: Pulls its aerial out so far that it tunes in to the ice-cream van and plays the jingle at bedtime.
lore.epic: Was snapped shut by every person at the reunion when someone said remember these.
lore.legendary: Was found in a drawer after fifteen years with one bar of battery and three unread texts from grandma.

names.legendary: Doctor Beepwell of the Night Shift

lore.common: Buzzes on your belt at the worst possible moment.
lore.uncommon: Shows only a number, so you have to guess who wants you.
lore.rare: Sent its owner running down the corridor to the nearest phone.
lore.epic: Buzzed every doctor in the hospital at the same time, and the corridor became a race.
lore.legendary: Buzzed so urgently that the doctor ran across the hospital and arrived before the buzz had finished.

lore.common: Has an antenna so big that it pokes people in the eye.
lore.uncommon: Only works when pointed at exactly the right bit of sky.
lore.rare: Called home from the middle of the ocean with a crystal-clear line.
lore.epic: Rang during the expedition photo on the ice, and a polar bear answered it.
lore.legendary: Called home from the top of the highest mountain to ask what was for tea, and was put on hold.

lore.common: Says over after every sentence, even at the dinner table.
lore.uncommon: Crackles so much that every message sounds like it's in a storm.
lore.rare: Let two children talk from opposite ends of the garden like secret agents.
lore.epic: Kept the whole camping trip chatting all night, and nobody slept a wink.
lore.legendary: Picked up a message from a passing pirate ship, and the children have been learning sea shanties ever since.

lore.common: Clips to its owner's belt and digs into their side every time they sit down.
lore.uncommon: Hops onto the wrong channel and joins a stranger's conversation about sandwiches.
lore.rare: Broadcasts every sneeze its owner makes to the whole festival crew.
lore.epic: Joined a taxi company channel by mistake, and the stewards sent forty taxis to the stadium.
lore.legendary: Said over and out so firmly that the match stopped and the whole crowd went home.

lore.common: Keeps dribbling sealant for ages after you let go of the trigger.
lore.uncommon: Draws a wobbly white line round the bath that looks like toothpaste.
lore.rare: Filled every gap in a draughty old window, and the curtains stopped flapping.
lore.epic: Sealed every bath in the block of flats, and also the doors, the windows and the builder.
lore.legendary: Sealed a leaky boat so well that it now floats upside down, just to show off.

names.legendary: Lady Stickwell of the Craft Table

lore.common: Leaves long stringy glue threads across everything like a hot cobweb.
lore.uncommon: Sticks your fingers together just when you're holding two things.
lore.rare: Fixed a broken model plane so well that it flew again.
lore.epic: Glued every decoration for the school fair, and the headteacher to the bunting.
lore.legendary: Built a whole cardboard castle with a drawbridge that actually works.

lore.common: Loses every foam dart under the sofa within a day.
lore.uncommon: Fires a dart so softly that it lands right in front of the shooter, every single time.
lore.rare: Hit a target across the garden and knocked over a whole stack of cups.
lore.epic: Started a foam dart battle that filled every room in the house.
lore.legendary: Lost so many darts under the sofa that the sofa now fires them back at bedtime.

lore.common: Clicks so loudly that the dog runs under the table.
lore.uncommon: Pops a little cap that smells of fireworks for ten seconds.
lore.rare: Fires a little flag that says BANG, and the flag always comes out back to front.
lore.epic: Popped its caps so loudly at the school fair that the brass band started playing in a panic.
lore.legendary: Popped its flag so high that it stuck on the school flagpole, and the school raises it every sports day.

names.legendary: Admiral Soakworth of the Paddling Pool

lore.common: Squirts the person holding it more than the person it's aimed at.
lore.uncommon: Needs pumping twenty times before it squirts more than a dribble.
lore.rare: Soaked someone over the top of the hedge without being seen.
lore.epic: Started a water fight at the summer barbecue that soaked every guest.
lore.legendary: Won the biggest water fight in the history of the street, and the street is still drying.

lore.common: Prints a tangle of spaghetti plastic when it gets bored halfway through.
lore.uncommon: Takes all night to build something the size of a thumb.
lore.rare: Prints a tiny copy of anything it sees, so the house is now full of tiny cats.
lore.epic: Printed a dinosaur overnight so big that it would not fit through the door, so the school fair moved into the garage.
lore.legendary: Printed a whole tiny house, layer by layer, and a family of mice moved in.

lore.common: Labels everything in the house, including the cat.
lore.uncommon: Spits out a tiny strip of label with a happy little whirr.
lore.rare: Has labels that peel off by themselves after a week.
lore.epic: Labelled every drawer, box and folder in the office in one morning.
lore.legendary: Labelled the dog DOG so neatly that the dog finally knows what it is and has become very proud.

names.legendary: Old Linesworth of the Drawing Office

lore.common: Scribbles with its pens so loudly that the office sounds like a busy classroom.
lore.uncommon: Uses up a whole roll of paper on one drawing.
lore.rare: Draws every plan a little bit bigger, so the shed it planned came out the size of a barn.
lore.epic: Kept drawing after the paper ran out, across the floor, up the wall and onto the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Drew a bridge so long that it reached the next town before anyone said stop. The towns now share a picnic.

lore.common: Jams the paper exactly when you need to print your homework.
lore.uncommon: Says it's out of ink just after you've bought a new one.
lore.rare: Printed a whole stack of blank pages and acted like nothing was wrong.
lore.epic: Jammed on the night before every project was due, and the whole family stood round it.
lore.legendary: Printed one page so slowly that its owner grew a beard waiting, then printed a picture of the beard.

names.legendary: Old Scanwell of the Spare Room

lore.common: Flashes a bright green light right in your eyes when you peek under the lid.
lore.uncommon: Scans everything a little bit crooked.
lore.rare: Scans your hand whenever you lean on it and prints a ghostly glove.
lore.epic: Scanned the family albums so fast that every photo came out wonky, and now everyone stands slightly tilted.
lore.legendary: Scanned the cat by accident and printed a copy so lifelike that the dog has chased it for a week.

lore.common: Only works if you hold it out of the car window and wave it like a magic wand.
lore.uncommon: Stops the garage door halfway, so you have to duck under it.
lore.rare: Was pressed in a pocket by accident and opened the garage all afternoon.
lore.epic: Opened every garage door on the street at once when the signals got muddled.
lore.legendary: Opened the garage just in time for a runaway pony to shelter from a hailstorm, and the pony still visits.

names.legendary: Lord Clickfinder of the Living Room

lore.common: Changes the channel by itself the moment the football starts.
lore.uncommon: Has a battery lid that falls off and gets lost.
lore.rare: Was hogged by one person all evening, and nobody else got to choose.
lore.epic: Pressed its volume button by itself at midnight, and the whole street woke up to a cooking show.
lore.legendary: Controlled the television so well that the presenters started waving at the family.

names.legendary: Grand Remotron of the Home Cinema

lore.common: Has fifty buttons, and the family only ever uses three of them.
lore.uncommon: Takes an hour to set up, and still won't control the fan.
lore.rare: Switches the oven on whenever someone changes the channel, so dinner is always ready halfway through a film.
lore.epic: Turned on every gadget in the house at the same moment by mistake.
lore.legendary: Controlled a whole home cinema with one button, and the family finally watched a film without arguing.

lore.common: Blinks its lights all night in the hallway like a tiny disco.
lore.uncommon: Makes every video buffer just at the best part.
lore.rare: Sent such a strong signal that next door's tablet connected by mistake.
lore.epic: Dropped the wifi for the whole house during the big final, and everyone groaned at once.
lore.legendary: Has kept the whole family online for ten years and only needed restarting a thousand times.

lore.common: Loses its pen under the desk every single day.
lore.uncommon: Lets you draw on the tablet while looking at the screen, which takes ages to learn.
lore.rare: Felt every bit of pressure from the pen and drew lines like real paint.
lore.epic: Drew a whole comic book in one weekend for the school competition.
lore.legendary: Drew a door on the screen so well that the cat walked into the monitor looking for the other side.

names.legendary: Lady Pagewell of the Beach Towel

lore.common: Flickers black and white every time you turn a page.
lore.uncommon: Freezes on the last page you read, so the ending of every book stays a mystery for a week.
lore.rare: Lasts so long on one charge that it forgot what a charger looks like and hides from it.
lore.epic: Read a whole library of books on one holiday, and its owner got sunburnt from not looking up.
lore.legendary: Turned its pages so slowly at the beach that the tide came in and read the last chapter first.

names.legendary: Lady Swipewell of the Back Seat

lore.common: Gets a crack in its corner the very first week.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in sticky fingerprints after every use.
lore.rare: Glowed under the duvet at bedtime long after lights out.
lore.epic: Played cartoons for the whole car journey, and nobody asked are we there yet.
lore.legendary: Got so many sticky fingerprints that it now unlocks itself for any child in the family.

lore.common: Dings at the end of every line so loudly that the cat jumps.
lore.uncommon: Jams its keys together if you type too fast.
lore.rare: Has an ink ribbon that leaves black smudges on everyone's fingers.
lore.epic: Clattered all night while its owner finished a novel before the deadline.
lore.legendary: Dinged at the end of a line so loudly that a ship in the harbour thought it was a bell and came in to dock.

lore.common: Leaves the carpet so soggy that nobody can walk on it for a day.
lore.uncommon: Hunts down every stain on the carpet, even the old juice ones.
lore.rare: Got the blackcurrant out of the white carpet, then put it back in the shape of a smiley face.
lore.epic: Shampooed the hotel carpets so thoroughly that they went fluffy, and the guests sank to their knees.
lore.legendary: Cleaned a rug so well that it remembered it was a flying carpet and left through the window.

names.legendary: Old Shinewell of the Town Square

lore.common: Spins its owner round in circles until they figure out how to steer.
lore.uncommon: Makes every corridor so shiny that shoes squeak on it all day.
lore.rare: Polished the school hall so well that the children skated in their socks.
lore.epic: Polished every corridor in the hospital overnight, and the doctors slid to work.
lore.legendary: Polished the town square so well that the pigeons skate to work.

lore.common: Hisses so loudly that the dog hides in the garden.
lore.uncommon: Blasts away the grime that has been stuck to the oven for years.
lore.rare: Filled the bathroom with so much steam that the mirror dripped for an hour.
lore.epic: Steamed the restaurant kitchen so hard that the chef could not find the soup for a week.
lore.legendary: Steamed a crumpled shirt so flat that it could be posted under the door like a letter.

lore.common: Has a volume knob that somebody always turns up just as the baby falls asleep.
lore.uncommon: Whines with feedback whenever the microphone gets too close.
lore.rare: Made a garage band sound like a stadium concert.
lore.epic: Blasted the battle of the bands so loudly that the school windows shook.
lore.legendary: Played one chord so loud at the school concert that the echo is still going round the gym.

names.legendary: Grand Boomworth of the Back Garden

lore.common: Thumps the bass so hard that the pictures on the wall shake.
lore.uncommon: Crackles when the dust gets in its cone.
lore.rare: Plays the bass so low that only the dog can hear it, and the dog has started dancing.
lore.epic: Boomed so loudly at the block party that the whole street danced.
lore.legendary: Played a bass note so deep that the moles in the garden came up to ask the name of the song.

lore.common: Loses one tooth every week until it looks like a gappy smile.
lore.uncommon: Tugs at every tangle and makes you say ow.
lore.rare: Made a parting so straight that you could use it as a ruler.
lore.epic: Gave the whole class side partings on school photo day, and the photographer had to tilt the camera.
lore.legendary: Combed a hedge into a perfect parting, and the birds now nest neatly on either side.

lore.common: Gets left and right mixed up every morning.
lore.uncommon: Has two tiny lids that spin off and roll under the sink.
lore.rare: Splashed lens solution into its owner's eye by mistake.
lore.epic: Swapped lenses between two friends at the sleepover, and each saw the world exactly like the other.
lore.legendary: Kept a pair of lenses so clean that they can see into next week. Its owner always knows what is for dinner.

lore.common: Gets so hot that its fan has to scream to keep it cool.
lore.uncommon: Thinks a billion thoughts a second and still makes you wait.
lore.rare: Has tiny pins that bend if you look at them wrong.
lore.epic: Ran so fast when it was overclocked that the whole computer lifted off the desk.
lore.legendary: Thought so fast that it finished the game before the player pressed start, then asked for a harder one.

names.legendary: Grand Hubsworth of the Office Desk

lore.common: Has a nest of cables behind it so tangled that unplugging one turns off the desk lamp.
lore.uncommon: Has more ports than anyone will ever need.
lore.rare: Snapped every plug into place with one satisfying click.
lore.epic: Plugged in every gadget in the office on Monday morning, and the fuse box sighed.
lore.legendary: Connected so many things at once that the desk lamp started sending emails.

lore.common: Splatters toothpaste over the mirror the moment you turn it on.
lore.uncommon: Buzzes so hard that your teeth tingle.
lore.rare: Buzzes every thirty seconds, and the dog has learned to change rooms each time.
lore.epic: Buzzed so hard that it shook every picture off the bathroom wall and the mirror off its hook.
lore.legendary: Brushed the teeth of a crocodile at the zoo, and now the crocodile smiles at every visitor.

lore.common: Has a row of sliders that everyone fiddles with.
lore.uncommon: Boosts the bass so much that the floor wobbles.
lore.rare: Has little lights that dance up and down to the music.
lore.epic: Flashed its light bars so fast at the school disco that the whole hall danced in slow motion.
lore.legendary: Turned the treble up so high that the windows started singing along in harmony.

lore.common: Leaves a cloud of chalk dust floating round the classroom.
lore.uncommon: Gets clapped together outside to get the dust out.
lore.rare: Wiped the whole board clean in one swipe.
lore.epic: Wiped the board so clean that it wiped off the timetable, and there were no lessons until lunch.
lore.legendary: Wiped a sum off the board so firmly that nobody in town could do long division for a week.

lore.common: Has a cable so short that it dangles off the desk and pulls itself to the floor.
lore.uncommon: Sits on the desk like a little black brick, humming quietly to itself.
lore.rare: Refuses to eject until you have said please three times. It counts.
lore.epic: Played fifty years of sports day photos on the hall screen at once, and the teachers saw their old haircuts.
lore.legendary: Survived a flood in the basement, dried out in the airing cupboard, and every file was still there.

lore.common: Goes through the washing machine in a jeans pocket at least once a month.
lore.uncommon: Hangs on a lanyard round its owner's neck like a tiny medal.
lore.rare: Carried the slideshow to the big meeting when the internet went down.
lore.epic: Was plugged into the wrong computer at the conference, and three hundred people saw holiday photos.
lore.legendary: Held so many files that it got heavy, and now needs its own lanyard and a small trolley.

lore.common: Snaps shut like a clam on your fingers.
lore.uncommon: Gets sat on every time it's left on the sofa, and survives every time.
lore.rare: Keeps a little cleaning cloth inside that nobody ever uses.
lore.epic: Was searched for by the whole family when grandad's glasses went missing, and they were on his head.
lore.legendary: Snapped shut on a seagull stealing chips, and the seagull returned every chip with a little bow.

names.legendary: Grand Polygonia of the Gaming Rig

lore.common: Roars its fans so loudly that it sounds like a hairdryer.
lore.uncommon: Lights up in rainbow colours inside the computer case for no reason.
lore.rare: Pushed so many pixels that the game looked more real than the window.
lore.epic: Ran every game at the same time during the game night, and the room got warm.
lore.legendary: Drew a sunset on the screen so real that the family put on sun cream.

lore.common: Hoards so much hair in its bristles that it looks like a small hedgehog.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the bathroom drawer under the hairdryer cord every morning, on purpose.
lore.rare: Brushed hair so hard that it stood straight up with static.
lore.epic: Brushed the dog so hard that there was enough fluff to knit a second dog.
lore.legendary: Brushed the frizz out of a thundercloud, and now it rains in perfectly straight lines.

names.legendary: Old Platterly of the Computer Case

lore.common: Clicks loudly when it's tired, and everyone panics.
lore.uncommon: Takes ages to spin up before anything happens.
lore.rare: Hides your homework in a folder called Spare, inside a folder called Old, inside one called Do Not Open.
lore.epic: Spun up so loudly in the office that everyone thought a plane was landing and hid under their desks.
lore.legendary: Spun for so long without stopping that it now powers the desk lamp all by itself.

names.legendary: Old Creakwell of the Garden Gate

lore.common: Squeaks every time the door opens, so nobody can sneak in.
lore.uncommon: Traps your fingers in its crack when you're not looking.
lore.rare: Swung a door shut behind a burglar so firmly that he stayed in the shed until morning.
lore.epic: Squeaked on every door in the old house at the same time, and it sounded like a choir.
lore.legendary: Creaked the garden gate open so slowly that the postman retired before it finished.

names.legendary: Old Inkwell of the Post Office

lore.common: Leaves inky fingerprints on every piece of paper.
lore.uncommon: Dries up just when you need to stamp something important.
lore.rare: Prints every stamp backwards, but only when the boss is watching.
lore.epic: Stamped the post office cat by mistake, and the cat was posted to the seaside.
lore.legendary: Has inked so many fingerprints that it can tell who ate the biscuits from the crumbs on their thumb.

lore.common: Gets flipped on and off by every curious child who walks past.
lore.uncommon: Clicks with a satisfying snap every single time.
lore.rare: Switches off whatever is most exciting: the telly during a goal, the oven during a cake.
lore.epic: Was flipped by a curious child in the control room, and every factory machine played a tune instead.
lore.legendary: Turned off every light in town at once, and everybody found their missing slippers by starlight.

names.legendary: Old Flintwell of the High Cupboard

lore.common: Clicks ten times without a spark, then works for someone else first time.
lore.uncommon: Has a little wheel that gives your thumb a sore spot after one try.
lore.rare: Hides in a different drawer every time a child walks into the kitchen.
lore.epic: Clicked so loudly at the school fair that a flock of pigeons flew up and landed on the cake stall.
lore.legendary: Went camping with grandad and was never needed, because grandad rubbed two sticks together for six hours instead.

lore.common: Tickles your nose every time it touches your face.
lore.uncommon: Puffs a little cloud of powder into the air with every stroke.
lore.rare: Blended colours so smoothly that nobody could see where one ended.
lore.epic: Tickled every nose before the ballet, and the whole cast sneezed in time with the music.
lore.legendary: Painted rosy cheeks on a snowman so well that it blushed and melted.

lore.common: Goes into the camera upside down every time, and the camera sulks.
lore.uncommon: Deletes the best photo first whenever it is nearly full, and keeps all the blurry ones.
lore.rare: Was swapped between cameras so fast that nobody missed a single shot.
lore.epic: Filled up with photos of every moment of the holiday, and the family needed a whole evening to watch them.
lore.legendary: Was found in a seagull nest, full of photos of the whole coastline, all taken by the seagull.

lore.common: Has slots for everything and still never has enough.
lore.uncommon: Has tiny lights that blink when it's thinking.
lore.rare: Has a tiny city on it where the electricity takes the long way round, so the computer is always late.
lore.epic: Was built in upside down by the computer club, and now every game plays from the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Has so many lights blinking that passing ships now use it as a lighthouse.

lore.common: Makes the phone too fat to fit into any pocket.
lore.uncommon: Has glitter inside that floats around when you tilt it.
lore.rare: Saved the phone from a fall down the stairs without a scratch.
lore.epic: Survived being dropped by every child in the class during the playground test.
lore.legendary: Has protected the same phone through a thousand drops and one swim in the bath.

lore.common: Rattles so loudly that grandma's handbag sounds like a maraca.
lore.uncommon: Has a little lid for every day of the week.
lore.rare: Gets the days muddled and insists it is Thursday all week. Grandma has given up arguing.
lore.epic: Rattled so loudly on the coach trip that the grandparents started a conga line down the aisle.
lore.legendary: Rattled such a catchy beat that grandma started a band, and her pill box plays the maracas on tour.

lore.common: Refuses to go into its slot until you have pushed, wiggled and sighed at least three times.
lore.uncommon: Gets swapped out every time the computer gets slow.
lore.rare: Remembers everything you typed, including the email you deleted, and reads it out at dinner.
lore.epic: Was fitted in every school computer, and they started reminding the teachers of things, loudly.
lore.legendary: Remembers where every lost sock in the house has gone, and the socks are not happy about it.

lore.common: Leaves little bits of shaving foam behind the ears.
lore.uncommon: Needs a mountain of shaving cream before it'll start.
lore.rare: Shaves one side of the face perfectly and leaves the other side for tomorrow.
lore.epic: Left so much foam in the bathroom that the family had a snowball fight before breakfast.
lore.legendary: Gave a lumberjack his first shave in twenty years, and his family didn't recognise him at dinner.

lore.common: Has a dial that's never quite on the right station.
lore.uncommon: Hunts through static until it finds a song.
lore.rare: Hummed so warmly that the music sounded like a live band.
lore.epic: Found a station playing only bagpipes and got stuck on it for the whole family party.
lore.legendary: Tuned in to a station so far away that it picked up a radio show hosted by a lighthouse cat.

lore.common: Eats every sock left on the floor and then gets stuck.
lore.uncommon: Is scared of stairs and turns round at the edge.
lore.rare: Was ridden around the house by the cat for a whole afternoon.
lore.epic: Escaped through the cat flap at midnight and vacuumed the whole street, including a sleeping fox.
lore.legendary: Was ridden by the cat for so long that the cat now does the cleaning while the robot naps on the sofa.

lore.common: Scratches your fingers more than the wood.
lore.uncommon: Makes a cloud of dust that gets in everyone's eyes.
lore.rare: Smoothed a splintery plank until it felt like silk.
lore.epic: Sanded every chair in the workshop in one day, and the dust filled the garden.
lore.legendary: Smoothed a mountain path so well that the goats slid all the way down to the village for breakfast.

names.legendary: Little Flashcard of the Trail Camera

lore.common: Needs a fingernail to flick it out of the slot.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck in the card reader and won't come out.
lore.rare: Pops out of the camera at the exact moment the deer walks past.
lore.epic: Caught a badger, a fox and an owl on the same night in the trail camera.
lore.legendary: Caught a hedgehog sneaking into the kitchen every night, and the family now leave it a bowl and a tiny napkin.

names.legendary: Old Channelworth of the TV Stand

lore.common: Starts an update just as the film is about to begin.
lore.uncommon: Never responds to the remote because something is blocking it.
lore.rare: Recorded every episode of the show even when the family forgot.
lore.epic: Recorded every channel at once on the night of the big final, then played them all back at the same time.
lore.legendary: Has recorded so many shows that it knows how every one ends, and gives the endings away at breakfast.

names.legendary: Old Whetwell of the Butcher's Block

lore.common: Makes a scraping sound that sends the cat out of the room.
lore.uncommon: Whizzes along every blade in the kitchen drawer.
lore.rare: Found the perfect edge on a knife that hadn't cut a tomato in years.
lore.epic: Sharpened the restaurant knives so well that the carrots started slicing themselves in a panic.
lore.legendary: Sharpened a butter knife so finely that it can slice a soap bubble in half without popping it.

lore.common: Is so tiny that it disappears if you breathe on it.
lore.uncommon: Needs a special pin to pop out its tray.
lore.rare: Kept its owner's phone number through five different phones.
lore.epic: Was swapped into the wrong phone, and grandma spent a week answering the football team chat.
lore.legendary: Made a call from the bottom of the sea, and the fish on the line asked for the football scores.

names.legendary: Old Thumpwell of the Town Hall

lore.common: Leaves an inky smudge everywhere it's pressed.
lore.uncommon: Is always pressed upside down by accident.
lore.rare: Thumped its approval on so many papers that the desk shook.
lore.epic: Stamped APPROVED on a plan for a slide from the office roof, and the slide was built by Friday.
lore.legendary: Thumped its approval so loudly that the whole town hall clapped. The plan was for a new bin.

lore.common: Buffers right at the most exciting moment of the show.
lore.uncommon: Hides round the back of the TV, so nobody can find it when it needs restarting.
lore.rare: Played a whole series in one weekend without a single pause.
lore.epic: Buffered at the big finale on every screen in the street, and the whole street groaned at once.
lore.legendary: Remembers where you stopped so well that it now finishes your sentences, but only with spoilers.

lore.common: Gets a little gunk in the bottom that nobody wants to clean.
lore.uncommon: Is crowded with every toothbrush in the family.
lore.rare: Stuck to the wall with a sucker that let go in the middle of the night.
lore.epic: Swapped every toothbrush on the family holiday, and nobody noticed until dad used the one for the dog.
lore.legendary: Grew so much gunk in the bottom that a tiny garden appeared, and grandma now waters it.

lore.common: Has cables sticking out in every direction like a spider.
lore.uncommon: Overloads when you plug in one too many gadgets.
lore.rare: Charged five gadgets at once without a single flicker.
lore.epic: Plugged in every gadget on the desk at once, and the desk looked like a jungle.
lore.legendary: Charged every gadget at a sleepover at once, and the house glowed so brightly that the owls complained.

lore.common: Lives on its owner's keyring and gets scratched by every key.
lore.uncommon: Has its cap chewed by its owner during exams.
lore.rare: Copies every file it touches and hides the word snack somewhere in each one.
lore.epic: Printed every essay at the library at once, and the printers buried the librarian up to her glasses.
lore.legendary: Was chewed so much during exams that its teeth marks are now shaped like the answers.

lore.common: Clacks its lid open and shut so loudly that everyone in the room turns round.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its lid shut with a satisfying clink.
lore.rare: Clinks its lid in time with any song, so every sing-along gets a drum solo.
lore.epic: Clacked its lid open and shut so fast at the campsite that every owl in the wood clacked back.
lore.legendary: Went round the world in an explorer's pocket and was never lit once, because he only used it to crack walnuts.
